metadata.purpose: Round 2 PETase engineering — evidence-based design pipeline
metadata.hard_rule: These thresholds are LOCKED. Any change requires a new versioned file (thresholds_v3.json) with a logged justification. NEVER edit this file after any results have been seen.
forbidden_actions: Edit this file after seeing any pipeline results
Report predicted Tm as measured Tm
Convert predicted ddG to Tm without a cited empirical calibration
Report RMSD of exactly 0.0000 without investigation

step_1_retrospective_validation.gate_name: ThermoMPNN Spearman rho vs experimental delta_Tm
step_1_retrospective_validation.action_if_fail: BLOCK design steps 3 and 4. Report as NEGATIVE/BLOCKED result. Exit.
step_1_retrospective_validation.action_if_pass: Proceed to design with explicit uncertainty labeling.
step_1_retrospective_validation.note: Signed rho expected negative (ddG down = more stable = ΔTm up). Gate checks |rho|.

step_2_site_selection.frozen_reason: Catalytic triad (Ser160/Asp206/His237) + native disulfides (Cys203-Cys239, Cys273-Cys289). No mutations permitted.
step_2_site_selection.b_factor_source: 6EQE.pdb CA atoms, averaged over chain A

design_gates.thermompnn_ddg_max_note: Only consider mutations with predicted ddG < 0.0 (predicted stabilizing). Strict gate.
design_gates.esm2_llr_min_note: ESM-2 LLR below -3.0 suggests the mutation is severely disruptive to the evolutionary sequence context. Reject.
design_gates.max_new_mutations_note: No more than 6 additional mutations on FAST-PETase or Hot-PETase background.

step_4_combinatorial.additivity_warning: Mandatory: state that sum-of-individual-ddG is an APPROXIMATION. Epistasis not modeled.
step_4_combinatorial.ranking_criterion: Sum of individual predicted ddG (lower = more stabilizing prediction)
step_4_combinatorial.finalist_label: computationally supported candidate for experimental testing

step_5_md.status_on_this_system: BLOCKED — pip install openmm timed out, no conda/mamba, GROMACS not installed
step_5_md.action_if_blocked: Report BLOCKED. Do not substitute guesses. Include BLOCKED status in final report.

step_6_prior_art.required_statement_format: No identical sequence found in [databases] searched on [date]
step_6_prior_art.automated_status: MANUAL_REQUIRED — BLAST API not available offline

output_labeling.finalist_label: computationally supported candidate for experimental testing — wet-lab validation required

assays_required: DSF or nanoDSF for Tm measurement (triplicates minimum)
PET film and PET powder activity at 40, 50, 60, 70°C
Comparison vs FAST-PETase, Hot-PETase, LCC-ICCG, and WT IsPETase controls
S160A catalytic knockout as negative control
wetlab_validation_plan.note: No computational result replaces wet-lab Tm measurement.
